home.heroSub: Track your income, expenses and budgets, and get spending insights that read your own entries — all in one place. Built for students, by students.
home.weather.title: Money Weather
home.weather.sub: A quick glance at how this month is going.
home.weather.cardSub: Three words, and the rule behind each
home.weather.calmBody: Spending sits under the budgets you set, and there is still room left in the month.
home.weather.watchBody: One category is close to its limit, or the month is going faster than the days are.
home.weather.actBody: Spending has passed what you planned, or a goal is at risk before the month ends.
home.weather.note: These are states, not numbers. Sign in and the app works out which one your month is in from your own entries.
home.journey.title: Your money, in order
home.journey.sub: From the day your allowance arrives to the day a goal fills up.
home.journey.incomeBody: Add your allowance or a part-time wage once, and every month starts from the same place.
home.journey.spendBody: Log a spend in a sentence, or scan a payment code, and it lands in the right category for you.
home.journey.budgetBody: A limit per category, and an alert the moment you come close to it.
home.journey.savingsBody: Money you moved out of spending, kept in a jar with the reason it is there.
home.journey.goalBody: A named goal the jar fills towards, so the saving has something to be for.
home.lab.title: What if you changed one thing?
home.lab.sub: Three questions about a month that has not happened yet, and the screen that answers each one.
home.lab.habitQ: What would this month look like if I ate out less?
home.lab.habitA: See your spending by category, and what one change would do to the total.
home.lab.weekQ: What does a normal week cost me?
home.lab.weekA: Your own entries averaged into a week, so the figure is yours and not a number borrowed from somewhere else.
home.lab.costQ: What is this actually costing me every month?
home.lab.costA: Every repeat and every subscription, totalled — including the ones you have not used.
home.lab.savingsHeadline: What a university holds for you
home.lab.savingsBody: Scholarship deadlines, student loans and fee plans, written down once and kept in one place.
home.lab.growthTitle: Small amounts, given somewhere to grow
home.lab.growthBody: Fixed deposits and government savings schemes, with the real rate beside each one instead of a promise.
home.faqQ1: How do I create an account?
home.faqA1: Open Register, fill in your name, email address and a password, then verify the email. It takes about a minute.
home.faqA2: Your entries stay yours. Nothing is shared, nothing is sold, and the whole app works without a bank connection.
home.faqA3: Yes. Any report can be saved as a PDF or shared by email, and your transactions can be brought in from a CSV whenever you like.
home.faqQ4: How do I set a budget?
home.faqA4: Open Budgets, pick a category, set a limit and the month. You get an alert as you come close, and last month's figure stays beside it.
home.faqA5: There is nothing to install. The same site works on a phone, with the big controls along the bottom for one-handed use.
